baseline-assesment.instructions: Instructions: Thinking about the last two weeks, please choose the option that you think fits you best for the following statements.
baseline-assesment.sadness_anxiety: I often feel sad or anxious.
baseline-assesment.emotion_control: I find it very difficult to control my emotions.
baseline-assesment.worry_anxiety: I often worry and feel anxious.
baseline-assesment.sensitivity_agitation: I am more agitated and sensitive than others.
baseline-assesment.physical_weakness: I feel physically weak or have frequent aches and pains.
baseline-assesment.body_health_concerns: I think there is something seriously wrong with my body.
baseline-assesment.slow_movements: I am slower in my movements and reactions compared to others.
baseline-assesment.friendship_difficulty: I find it difficult to make friends with other children. I prefer to be alone.
baseline-assesment.communication_difficulty: I find it difficult to communicate with friends or family.
baseline-assesment.emotional_expression: I cannot talk openly about how I feel.
baseline-assesment.parental_overwhelm: I feel overwhelmed by my parents.
baseline-assesment.school_helplessness: I feel helpless in school in front of others.
baseline-assesment.concentration_problems: I have a hard time concentrating.
baseline-assesment.lack_happiness: There are few things that really make me happy.
baseline-assesment.maturity_pressure: I feel like I should have matured faster.
baseline-assesment.internet_dependency: I would feel lonely without the internet.
baseline-assesment.economic_bullying: I have been bullied or marginalized because I can't afford the same things as my friends or colleagues (for example: clothes, phone, etc.).
baseline-assesment.nightmares: I often have nightmares when I sleep.
baseline-assesment.substance_use: I have tried smoking or using illegal substances (alcohol, drugs, etc.) several times.
baseline-assesment.frequent_headaches: I have frequent headaches for no reason.

baseline-assesment-modal.heading: Baseline Assesment
baseline-assesment-modal.paragraph_1: The following questions will help you better understand how you are feeling and find out if you need help to feel better. The questions are about your mood, thoughts and feelings over the last two weeks. There are no right or wrong answers, just answers that represent you. It is important to answer as honestly as possible, so that we can understand what you are feeling and see how we can help you.
baseline-assesment-modal.paragraph_2: At the end, you will receive an answer that will show you how you are feeling and whether it would be important to talk to someone about what is happening to you. If necessary, we will tell you who you can go to for help – it could be a school counselor, a psychologist or another specialist.
baseline-assesment-modal.paragraph_3: Everything you answer here is confidential, no one asks for your name or other information that could indicate who you are. So you are safe, you can be open and honest. The questionnaire only takes a few minutes and can be a first step to feeling better.
baseline-assesment-modal.paragraph_4: Are you ready? Let's get started! 😊

how-it-works-mood-track.heading: How mood tracker works
how-it-works-mood-track.subheading_1: You can easily record your moods throughout the day or at custom time periods that suit you. Each entry helps build a personal mood history, allowing you to reflect on changes and patterns over time. It’s quick, private, and designed to fit naturally into your daily routine.
how-it-works-mood-track.subheading_2: When recording a mood, you can optionally mark it as a special or critical life event. You can also add comments to capture thoughts or details related to that moment. This helps give more context to your mood history.
how-it-works-mood-track.subheading_3: A chart will display your recorded moods by date and time, helping you visualize your emotional trends. Below it, you’ll find recommended content tailored to your most recent mood entry for support and insight.
how-it-works-mood-track.subheading_4: By clicking on a specific event, you can view all comments and notes recorded for that moment, giving you deeper insight into what influenced your mood.
how-it-works-mood-track.subheading_5: You can generate a report for any selected date range and export it as a CSV file, making it easy to review or share your mood data when needed.

how-it-works-ba.heading: How baseline assessment works
how-it-works-ba.subheading_1: Before accessing your baseline assessment, please review and accept the Privacy Policy. You must accept it to continue.
how-it-works-ba.subheading_2: You can also start the assessment anytime from your dashboard.
how-it-works-ba.subheading_3: The assessment is divided into multiple questions with a progress bar, and you can save your progress and continue later.
how-it-works-ba.subheading_4: When you continue your assessment, you’ll see the start date and your saved progress, and you’ll pick up right where you left off.
how-it-works-ba.subheading_5: When you complete the assessment, you’ll see your psychological, biological, and social results. You can retake it later to compare changes in your well-being, and related content based on your results will appear below.
how-it-works-ba.subheading_6: Once completed, your results will appear in the dashboard, along with an option to retake the assessment anytime.
how-it-works-ba.subheading_7: Stat changes are shown with green or red arrows, comparing only your most recent results to the previous assessment.
